rules._comment_general: Wrapper uses Admin SDK and bypasses these rules. Watch clients authenticate via Anonymous Auth — each device has a stable UID. Reads + /command and /prompt writes are pinned to a known list of UIDs. To add a new device: launch the app on it, then grep logcat for 'Notifying id token listeners about user ( <UID> )' and add that UID to the lists below, then republish.
rules._comment_uids: Replace the two placeholder UIDs below with your own. The first slot is your Wear OS emulator's anonymous UID, the second is your real Galaxy Watch 8's UID. Both come from the watch's logcat the first time the app launches.
rules._comment_force_reset: Long-press force reset (CcwearosRepository.forceResetUi) does one multi-path update: status=IDLE and null on sharedSession, permissionPrompt, permissionPromptId, activity, task, command. The watch may ONLY write those exact values on those paths.

command..write: auth != null && (auth.uid === 'EMULATOR_UID_HERE' || auth.uid === 'REAL_WATCH_UID_HERE') && (!newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['text', 'issuedAt']) && newData.child('text').isString() && newData.child('issuedAt').isNumber() && (!newData.child('promptId').exists() || newData.child('promptId').isString())))

rules._comment_claim: Sprint 4n — tap-to-claim. Watch writes /claimRequest when the user taps a session row + confirms. Daemon reads, spawns `cc --resume <id>` via osascript, writes /claimResult. The wrapper bypasses these rules (Admin SDK). Watch needs WRITE on /claimRequest (full payload) and on /claimResult ONLY to null it after auto-dismiss (no replacement payload allowed).

claimRequest..write: auth != null && (auth.uid === 'EMULATOR_UID_HERE' || auth.uid === 'REAL_WATCH_UID_HERE') && (!newData.exists() || (newData.hasChildren(['sessionId', 'cwd', 'issuedAt']) && newData.child('sessionId').isString() && newData.child('cwd').isString() && newData.child('issuedAt').isNumber()))
